title: Prepaid Calibration Unit Schedule, CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan
content:
Calibration work on the CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan is measured in calibration units. Each tier grants an allotment of prepaid units for the plan year, sets how many unused units roll over, offers or withholds mid-year top-ups and fixes the price of a unit used when no prepaid unit is available.

## Schedule by tier

| Tier | Prepaid units granted per plan year | Rollover of unused units (percent) | Unused units not rolled over expire at year end | Top-up price per unit (USD) | Smallest top-up (units) | Standard unit price (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CalCare Pay-Per-Service | 0 | 0 | yes | 0.00 (top-ups not offered) | 0 | 89.00 |
| CalCare Basic Plan | 10 | 0 | yes | 72.00 | 5 | 79.00 |
| CalCare Standard Plan | 30 | 10 | yes | 66.00 | 10 | 72.00 |
| CalCare Accredited Plan | 60 | 20 | yes | 60.00 | 20 | 68.00 |
| CalCare Onsite Plan | 150 | 25 | yes | 55.00 | 25 | 62.00 |
| CalCare Enterprise Plan | 400 | 25 | yes | 48.00 | 50 | 55.00 |

## Definitions

1. **Prepaid units granted per plan year**: calibration units granted at the start of each plan year.
2. **Rollover**: percent of unused units (rounded down to whole units) carried into the next plan year; the rest expire.
3. **Expiry at year end**: whether unused units not rolled over expire at the plan year end.
4. **Top-up price per unit**: price per prepaid unit bought mid-year, USD; 0.00 means top-ups are not offered.
5. **Smallest top-up**: smallest top-up purchase in units.
6. **Standard unit price**: price per calibration unit when no prepaid unit is available, USD.

## Notes on the schedule

- CalCare Pay-Per-Service grants 0 prepaid units and its top-up price is 0.00, so top-ups are not offered on that tier and every unit it uses is priced at its standard unit price of 89.00.
- CalCare Basic Plan grants 10 units but rolls over 0 percent, so none of its unused units carry into the next plan year.
- On every tier, unused units that do not roll over expire at the plan year end.
- The standard unit price falls tier by tier from 89.00 on CalCare Pay-Per-Service to 55.00 on CalCare Enterprise Plan, and on each tier offering top-ups the top-up price is below that tier's standard unit price.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A CalCare Accredited Plan customer buying a top-up must buy at least 20 units; 20 units at 60.00 each come to 1200.00.
